title: test(devx): give layout, test-support and console-starter a package-level test entry, each measured on its own
body:
Fixes #8991

Three packages carried **no `test` script at all**, so `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` exited **0 having written 0 bytes** — a silent false green over test files the root config does collect and does run. This adds one script line per package, each decided and measured **separately**.

## The population, derived by invocation (not by reading manifests)

The card's triage says a probe shaped like the example you already found cannot measure the class, and that manifest-reading under-counts because a `test` script can exist and still match nothing. So the population here was derived by **invoking all 47 workspace manifests** and comparing each package's own entry against the root config's collection for that directory.

- **B side** — one unfiltered root-config collection, bucketed by directory: **2960 unique files** across the `unit`, `dom`, `dom-heavy` and `@object-ui/console` projects.
- **A side** — each package's own `test` entry re-invoked in list mode (`run` swapped for `list --filesOnly`, every other token of the declared script kept verbatim), run from that package's directory exactly as pnpm launches it. Packages with no script were invoked as `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` and their exit code and byte count recorded.

Compared as **exact path sets**, not as counts:

| outcome | count | packages |
|:--|--:|:--|
| package entry collects the identical path set as the root config | 41 | every script-bearing package, including the `@object-ui/types` control at **174** files |
| **no `test` script, root config collects files** | **3** | `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/test-support`, `@object-ui/example-console-starter` |
| no `test` script, root config also collects nothing | 3 | `@object-ui/site`, `@object-ui/example-byo-backend-console`, `@object-ui/example-hello-world` |

**Against the card and the dispatch floor.** The card names **three** members; the dispatch seat's manifest reading found **six** manifests with no script. The invocation sweep returns **the same six**, and splits them into **3 real members** and **3 that are a different question** (below). ⇒ the manifest floor turned out to be **exact** here: **no script-bearing package under-collects today**. That is a measured negative, not an assumption — and it is the part manifest-reading could not have established.

The `@object-ui/types` control behaves as a fixed member: its entry and the root config agree on the same 174 paths. Note its **174 collected files** against the **175 test-named files on disk** quoted in the dispatch — the reminder that a filename glob is not a Vitest collection count, which is why every number below is re-derived by invocation.

## Per member: before, after, and the spelling chosen

Package-level = `pnpm --filter <pkg> test`. Root-config = `pnpm exec vitest run <dir>/` from the repo root.

| member | before (package-level) | after (package-level) | root-config (both before and after) | agree? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@object-ui/layout` | exit **0**, **0 bytes**, 0 files / 0 tests | exit 0, **21 files / 217 tests** | exit 0, **21 files / 217 tests** | ✅ |
| `@object-ui/test-support` | exit **0**, **0 bytes**, 0 files / 0 tests | exit 0, **5 files / 71 tests** | exit 0, **5 files / 71 tests** | ✅ |
| `@object-ui/example-console-starter` | exit **0**, **0 bytes**, 0 files / 0 tests | exit 0, **1 file / 9 tests** | exit 0, **1 file / 9 tests** | ✅ |

Each after-run reports its Vitest root as the repo root, confirming `--root ../..` took effect rather than the package directory (the trap where root-level project globs resolve against the package and collect somebody else's files).

### Why each one got the plain spelling, from that member's own facts

Three spellings exist in this tree — plain, `--passWithNoTests` (`plugin-ai`, the vscode extension), and `--no-passWithNoTests` (`@object-ui/console`, the opposite posture). The deciding fact is that the root config does not set `passWithNoTests` to a constant: it sets it to the **negation of whether the CLI named test filters**. All three scripts below carry a positional path filter, so that derives to **false** for them already.

- **`@object-ui/layout` — plain.** It has 21 collected files. A filter that ever stops matching must be loud, and the config already makes it loud for a filtered run: zero collected exits 1 on its own. `--passWithNoTests` here would be actively harmful — it would convert this very defect from silent-empty into silent-empty-with-a-blessing over 21 real files.
- **`@object-ui/test-support` — plain.** Same reasoning at 5 files. It has no `build` script, so the entry is placed first in its scripts block rather than after `build`.
- **`@object-ui/example-console-starter` — plain.** Same reasoning at 1 file, and it matches the only other `examples/*` member with an entry (`schema-catalog`), which uses the same form. `--no-passWithNoTests` was considered and rejected for all three as redundant: it would re-state what the config already derives for a filtered run, and it earns its place on `@object-ui/console` only because that entry filters by **project** rather than by path, which is not a test filter.

Two per-member facts were checked rather than assumed, because they are what made the `@object-ui/types` member of this class hard: **(1)** no test file in any of the three reads `process.cwd()`, so none can give a different verdict under the package-level cwd than under the repo-root cwd; **(2)** none imports its own Vite or Vitest config, so none re-enters the invocation guard inside a worker. The `console-starter` test does read its own Vite config, but as **text** through a path derived from `import.meta.url` — it never imports it, and that example's Vite config is one of the two templates that deliberately does not call the guard.

## The acceptance probe can fail — shown in both directions, per member

Per the requirement carried over from #8590, the filtered spelling has to **disagree with a broken test**, not merely exit 0. One real collected test per member was deliberately broken, the package-level entry re-run, then restored and re-run. Restore is proven by blob hash and by an empty `git diff HEAD`, never by an exit code.

| member | mutated assertion | RED leg | restored | GREEN leg |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `@object-ui/test-support` | `MAX_WRAPPER_DEPTH` expected `8` changed to `9` | **exit 1** — 1 failed \| 4 passed (5 files), 1 failed \| 70 passed (71 tests) | hash back to `b833680b6`, `git diff HEAD` empty | exit 0 — 5 files / 71 tests |
| `@object-ui/layout` | dispatched nav id `nav_export` changed to a non-matching literal | **exit 1** — 1 failed \| 20 passed (21 files), 1 failed \| 216 passed (217 tests) | hash back to `0c44a9ae8`, `git diff HEAD` empty | exit 0 — 21 files / 217 tests |
| `@object-ui/example-console-starter` | alias-table size floor `20` raised to `100000` | **exit 1** — 1 failed (1 file), 1 failed \| 8 passed (9 tests) | hash back to `0fc8387f6`, `git diff HEAD` empty | exit 0 — 1 file / 9 tests |

Each mutation was proven to have **landed on disk** before its run was believed — anchor occurrences counted down from 1 to 0 and mutant occurrences up from 0 to 1, with the on-disk blob hash printed at each step. An editing tool exiting 0 was not treated as evidence. The probe ran against the **committed** implementation and carried an `EXIT INT TERM` trap restoring an absolute path, so an interrupted run could not leave a mutated tree behind.

## Stopped and reported, ⛔ not fixed — the three zero-file packages

`@object-ui/site`, `@object-ui/example-byo-backend-console` and `@object-ui/example-hello-world` have no `test` script **and** no test files anywhere. The card anticipated these as a weaker sub-case wanting the `--passWithNoTests` variant. Measuring them says something the card could not have known, so they are reported instead of fixed:

**The root-config invocation for each of the three exits 1**, not 0 — a positional filter that collects nothing is precisely what the config's derived `passWithNoTests: false` is there to reject. So:

- the card's own acceptance definition — the two invocations reaching the same counts, **both exiting 0** — is **unreachable** for a package with zero test files; and
- adding `--passWithNoTests` would make the package entry exit **0** while the root-config comparison exits **1**, i.e. it would *manufacture* disagreement between exactly the two invocations this card requires to agree.

`@object-ui/site` carries a second, independent mechanism: the root config's shared exclude list ends with `apps/**`, and an app comes back through the projects array as its own project rooted at the app directory, so a path filter naming the app can never match — an app is reachable only by `--project`, and no `site` project exists. A `--passWithNoTests` entry there would be green by construction and could never notice a test file being added.

That is one decision for the triage seat, not a fix to guess at, and it is filed separately. ⛔ No test was skipped, disabled, quarantined or edited, no threshold lowered, and no filter loosened to make anything agree.

## Gates run, with the verdict each printed

| gate | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/` — where every manifest-reading gate test lives, including the turbo `test`-inputs guard that enumerates packages declaring a `test` script | exit 0 — **141 passed \| 2 skipped (143 files)**, **4192 passed \| 2 skipped (4194 tests)** |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 — `3 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 of them a manifest whose published contract moved` ⇒ `✅ No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` |
| `check:control-bytes` | exit 0 — `✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 7292 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` |
| `check:new-line-citations` | exit 0 — `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` |
| `check:phantom-deps` | exit 0 — `✅ Every in-scope import is declared by the package that publishes it.` |
| `check:unused-deps` | exit 0 — `✅ Every gated declaration has a consumer in the package that declares it.` |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test <the 3 manifests>` | `✅ NOT GOVERNED — 3 path(s) checked against 5 governed surface(s); none matched.` |

**No changeset is added**, because the gate printed that none is owed: only the `scripts` key moved in each manifest, which is not one of the eight published-contract fields, and no published source changed.

## Risk

CI runs the canonical root Vitest project, not `turbo run test`, so all 27 files and 297 tests reached by these three entries were **already running and already green** in CI before this change. What moves is the **developer-facing** entry point: `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` now runs the package's own tests instead of silently running nothing. No test file, source file or config is touched — the diff is three added lines in three manifests.
